===Valve's Regional Standings===
:''For more info on [https://github.com/ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings/tree/main Valve's Regional Standings].''
In 2023, [[Valve]] announced their own version of a team ranking which effectively acts as the seeding method (and later on direct invites) for teams at both the RMRs and Major from [[PGL/2024/Copenhagen|PGL Copenhagen 2024]] onwards.

The Legend/Challenger/Contender team status was not directly used with this change, however, the top 8 teams from the RMRs in accordance to the previous Major result and Valve's Regional Standings still received a bye to the second stage of the Major while the remaining teams would start from the first stage.

Following the expansion to a 32-team Major from [[BLAST/Major/2025/Austin|BLAST.tv Austin 2025]] onwards, the top 16 teams in accordance to the previous Major result and Valve's Regional Standings are directly invited to the next Major with the top 8 teams starting from Stage 3 while the next 8 would begin from Stage 2.

Following the 9th of June 2025 update to the [https://github.com/ValveSoftware/counter-strike_rules_and_regs/commit/2c85d431cb4788ca7cc57854759bf4fe01c8cae3 Major Supplemental Rulebook] where MRQ's were removed, all slots at the major are now filled directly by VRS invites according to the regional assignment as determined at the previous major.

Below are '''unofficial''' rankings generated using the [https://github.com/ValveSoftware/counter-strike_regional_standings VRS Model], using Liquipedia as a data source. Data collection and formatting of the below table can be accessed and modified [https://github.com/OpenVRS/counter-strike_regional_standings/blob/main/liquipedia/page_template.wiki here].
